bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
src=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test -d "$src/.git" || test -f "$src/.git" || exit 60
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 61
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 62
printf 'HOST_REPO_HEAD='; git -C /home/gace/Project/Gserver/repository rev-parse HEAD
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_SOURCE_HEAD='; git -C "$src" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_SOURCE_DIRTY='; if test -z "$(git -C "$src" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"; then echo NO; else echo YES; fi
printf 'LIVE_IMAGE_ID='; docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}'
printf 'LIVE_STICKER_SALES_SHA256='; docker exec "$cid" sha256sum /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerSales.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1
printf 'LIVE_MENU_PANEL_SHA256='; docker exec "$cid" sha256sum /opt/videobot/src/telegram/menuPanel.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1
echo SINGLE_POLL=PASS
